hero.name: Quiet statement over a ground
hero.from: Anthropic, Stripe Press, Mercury, private banks and advisers
hero.job: One calm sentence at 56px over a ground that fills the hero, the buttons, then four facts docked under a hairline. For a company whose product is trust or a service, when there is no strong picture. The ground carries the look: a dark horizon with a lit rim, a grainy field in the lit tone, a halo, dusk or (software) liquid.

grid.text: from the left line, h1 max 21ch, lead max 42ch
grid.facts: 4 x span-3 under a hairline, docked at the hero's foot (64 above the fold)

at1440.hero: 1440x900, the text block top-aligned (layout-v4.md section 3: the h1 first, top at y 120), the facts docked at the foot
at1440.order: pill 32 at y 120 (only for real news), 32, h1 56 (59.4) on 2 lines (from y 120 without the pill, y 184 with it), 24, lead 20/30 on 3 or 4 lines, 32, buttons 44; the four facts under a hairline at the hero's foot
at1440.ground: the demo: bg-horizon on a dark page (the lit rim rises from the hero's foot behind the facts)
at1440.measured: hero 900/900, h1 59px (weight 400) on 2 lines, its box from y 120 (no pill)

at390.measured: hero 844/844, h1 36px on 3 lines from y 96 (80 on a place page: --hgap 24)

hero.moment: the ground: liquid (two slow blobs, software only, with its pause disc) or a still horizon, field, halo, dusk or grain
mistakes: a pale wash that reads as an empty page
a ground that fights the words
a second visual on the hero
a lead longer than three lines
liquid-type (tech only) on a headline of more than six words: it is for a short, large one
